mission.goal: Reach first $100 MRR with disciplined experimentation

steps.objective: You are the Product specialist. Mission goal: Reach first $100 MRR with disciplined experimentation. Constraints: target_mrr_usd=100, max_days=14, max_cash_spend_usd=200. Return: 1) selected opportunity id, 2) why this is best now, 3) next executable product step.
steps.reply:
[simulation] Product agent completed opportunity selection. Selected: opp_001 - Overdue invoices are followed up manually and too late because owners avoid awkward collection messages.. ICP: Freelancer / small service owner / Professional services / 1-20. MVP scope includes 6 features with priority around follow-up queue orchestration, rule-based reminders, and template-driven outbound copy for overdue invoice recovery.

Handoff contract is written to product_to_marketing.json with status ready_for_marketing_review. Next executable step is to activate the marketing pipeline using prepared ICP positioning and content assets.

steps.objective: Based on Product direction, provide 3 channel-light GTM experiments for first 14 days. Return: experiment, expected signal, fail threshold.
steps.reply:
[simulation] Marketing agent completed GTM simulation for early demand generation. Built 9 campaign records: 3 launch_ready and 5 watchlist. Produced 12 content assets spanning linkedin, email_nurture, organic_search with channel-light tests tied to BOFU intent.

Lead model estimates 25 weekly leads from current launch mix. Qualified lead signals and campaign readiness are packaged for Sales handoff in marketing_to_sales.json.

steps.objective: Provide minimal early sales motion for first $100 MRR. Return: target segment, outreach opener, qualification rule, close trigger.
steps.reply:
[simulation] Sales agent completed pipeline execution for first revenue conversion. Contacted 13 prospects, received 6 replies, booked 1 call, and converted 1 customer at MRR $49. Primary objection observed: budget (2 cases).

Current conversion performance is 1/13 = 7.7% with clear signal to tighten pricing narrative and trust handling. Next step is Operations feedback integration to resolve objections and expand MRR.

steps.objective: Provide weekly operating cadence and KPI board for this venture. Return: KPI list, daily check, weekly review, rollback conditions.
steps.reply:
[simulation] Operations agent completed feedback triage and KPI loop closure. Prioritized 10 items with top themes: trust, pricing, retention, onboarding. Identified 6 P2 actions with expected 30-day MRR delta around $37.5.

Top recommendations are to audit outreach targeting with permission controls and deploy a low-risk pilot offer with ROI proof for pricing objections. Iteration handoffs are prepared for Product, Marketing, and Sales.
